)

const packagePath = "github.com/viant/datly/testfixture/predicatereload/records"

type reloadFixture struct {
	db        *sqlite.Harness
	stage     string
	resources []*resource.Store
}

// Discovery reads the emitted holder and manifest. Reflection below links only
// types compiled by go test from that emitted package; it constructs no types.
func (f *reloadFixture) compile(ctx context.Context, types *typecatalog.Catalog) (*application.Build, error) {
	workspace, err := (xmodule.LocalWorkspace{BaseDir: f.stage}).Resolve(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	routes, err := (bootstrap.PackageDiscovery{Workspace: workspace, Include: []string{packagePath}}).Discover(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(routes) != 1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("discovered %d routes", len(routes))
	}
	if err = routes[0].ValidateContractTypes(reflect.TypeOf(RecordsInput{}), reflect.TypeOf(RecordsOutput{})); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	component, err := routes[0].Resolve(reflect.TypeOf(RecordsInput{}), reflect.TypeOf(RecordsOutput{}))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	assets, err := (packageresources.Loader{Workspace: workspace, Packages: []string{packagePath}}).Load(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	artifact, err := bootstrap.BuildArtifact(bootstrap.ArtifactInput{Component: component, Types: types, Resources: assets.Store, InputType: reflect.TypeOf(RecordsInput{}), OutputType: reflect.TypeOf(RecordsOutput{})})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	reader, err := artifact.ReaderCompilation().NewExecution(bootstrap.ReaderRuntimeConfig{SQL: &dsql.SQLComponent{DB: f.db.DB}})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	f.resources = append(f.resources, assets.Store)
	return &application.Build{Types: types, Resources: assets.Store, Components: []*registry.RegisteredComponent{{Component: artifact.Component, Input: artifact.Input, Output: artifact.Output, OutputType: reflect.TypeOf(RecordsOutput{}), Reader: reader}}}, nil
}

type publicClient struct {
	manager  *application.Manager
	native   *client.Client
	ctx      context.Context
	registry bool
}

func (c publicClient) rows(t *testing.T, maximum int) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, minimum := range []int{0, 2, 4, 5} {
		var body []byte
		if !c.registry && c.native == nil {
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			c.manager.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest("GET", fmt.Sprintf("/records?min=%d", minimum), nil).WithContext(c.ctx))
			if response.Code != 200 {
				t.Fatalf("HTTP %d: %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
			}
			body = response.Body.Bytes()
		} else {
			result, err := c.callTool(&schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: "records.query", Arguments: map[string]any{"minimum": minimum}})
			if err != nil || result == nil || result.IsError != nil && *result.IsError {
				t.Fatalf("MCP result=%+v err=%v", result, err)
			}
			body, err = json.Marshal(result.StructuredContent)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		var actual struct {
			Data []struct {
				ID int `json:"id"`
			} `json:"data"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &actual); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		want := []int{}
		got := []int{}
		for id := 1; id <= maximum; id++ {
			if id >= minimum {
				want = append(want, id)
			}
		}
		for _, row := range actual.Data {
			got = append(got, row.ID)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("minimum=%d rows=%v want=%v body=%s", minimum, got, want, body)
		}
	}
}

func (c publicClient) required(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	if !c.registry && c.native == nil {
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		c.manager.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/records", nil).WithContext(c.ctx))
		if response.Code != 422 || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "minimum required") {
			t.Fatalf("required HTTP: %d %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
		}
		return
	}
	result, err := c.callTool(&schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: "records.query", Arguments: map[string]any{}})
	// Missing business arguments are rejected by MCP's schema/input boundary,
	// before the HTTP/Bindly required-message path can execute.
	var rpcErr *jsonrpc.Error
	if !errors.As(err, &rpcErr) || rpcErr.Code != jsonrpc.InvalidParams || rpcErr.Message != `missing required MCP argument "minimum"` || result != nil {
		t.Fatalf("required MCP: %+v %v", result, err)
	}
}

func (c publicClient) schema(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	if !c.registry && c.native == nil {
		return
	}
	listed, err := c.listTools()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(listed.Tools) != 1 || listed.Tools[0].Name != "records.query" {
		t.Fatalf("business tools: %+v", listed.Tools)
	}
	tool := listed.Tools[0]
	want := schema.ToolInputSchema{Type: "object", Required: []string{"minimum"}, Properties: map[string]map[string]any{"minimum": {"type": "integer"}}}
	actual := tool.InputSchema
	// The native decoder retains absent extension keys as an empty map;
	// direct registry values use nil. Preserve all nonempty extensions.
	if extensions, ok := actual.AdditionalProperties.(map[string]interface{}); ok && len(extensions) == 0 {
		actual.AdditionalProperties = nil
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(actual, want) {
		t.Fatalf("business input schema: %+v", tool.InputSchema)
	}
	// Business tooling currently advertises the input schema. The runtime
	// output is checked as exact rows; no output-schema/annotation claim is made.
}

// This is an explicitly separate registry check, never a wire fallback.
func (c publicClient) callTool(params *schema.CallToolRequestParams) (*schema.CallToolResult, error) {
	if c.native != nil {
		return c.native.CallTool(c.ctx, params)
	}
	pinned, service, err := c.manager.Pin(c.ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	entry, ok := service.Registry().ToolRegistry.Get(params.Name)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing tool %s", params.Name)
	}
	result, rpcErr := entry.Handler(pinned, &schema.CallToolRequest{Method: schema.MethodToolsCall, Params: *params})
	if rpcErr != nil {
		return result, rpcErr
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (c publicClient) listTools() (*schema.ListToolsResult, error) {
	if c.native != nil {
		return c.native.ListTools(c.ctx, nil)
	}
	_, service, err := c.manager.Pin(c.ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &schema.ListToolsResult{Tools: service.Registry().ListRegisteredTools()}, nil
}

func TestPublicReload(t *testing.T) {
	stage1, err := filepath.Abs("..")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stage2 := os.Getenv("DATLY_RELOAD_STAGE")
	if stage2 == "" {
		t.Fatal("second emitted generation is required")
	}
	// Static validation has a read-only contract and explicitly reports checks it
	// does not perform. Runtime/public assertions below are separate evidence.
	for _, stage := range []string{stage1, stage2} {
		var snapshots [2]map[string]string
		for pass := range snapshots {
			snapshots[pass] = map[string]string{}
			if err = filepath.WalkDir(stage, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if !entry.IsDir() {
					data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					snapshots[pass][path] = string(data)
				}
				return nil
			}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if pass == 0 {
				report, err := (&transcribe.Validator{BaseDir: stage, Include: []string{packagePath}}).Validate(context.Background())
				if err != nil || !report.Valid || len(report.Components) != 1 || len(report.Completed) != 3 || len(report.Skipped) == 0 || len(report.Schema) != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("static validation report=%+v err=%v", report, err)
				}
			}
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(snapshots[0], snapshots[1]) {
			t.Fatal("static validation changed emitted workspace")
		}
	}
	for _, protocol := range []struct{ name, version string }{{"http", ""}, {"mcp-registry", ""}, {"mcp-session", schema.LegacyProtocolVersion}, {"mcp-stateless", schema.LatestProtocolVersion}} {
		t.Run(protocol.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			db := sqlite.New(t)
			if err := db.ExecStatements(ctx, "CREATE TABLE records(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)", "INSERT INTO records VALUES(1),(2),(3),(4)"); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			types := typecatalog.NewCatalog()
			for _, typ := range []reflect.Type{reflect.TypeOf(Threshold{}), reflect.TypeOf(RecordsInput{}), reflect.TypeOf(RecordsOutput{})} {
				if err := types.Register(typecatalog.TypeOriginPackage, x.NewType(typ)); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			manager, err := application.New(types)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			fixture := &reloadFixture{db: db, stage: stage1}
			if err = manager.Reload(ctx, application.Request{Revision: 1, Compile: fixture.compile}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			current := publicClient{ctx: ctx, manager: manager, registry: protocol.name == "mcp-registry"}
			if protocol.version != "" {
				current.native = (mcpclient.Config{Source: manager, ProtocolVersion: protocol.version}).New(t)
			}
			current.schema(t)
			current.rows(t, 3)
			current.required(t)
			pinned, service, err := manager.Pin(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			old := publicClient{ctx: pinned, manager: manager, registry: protocol.name == "mcp-registry"}
			if protocol.version != "" {
				old.native = (mcpclient.Config{Service: service, ProtocolVersion: protocol.version}).New(t)
			}
			fixture.stage = stage2
			if err = manager.Reload(ctx, application.Request{Revision: 2, Compile: fixture.compile}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if manager.Revision() != 2 {
				t.Fatal("revision not published")
			}
			current.schema(t)
			current.rows(t, 4)
			current.required(t)
			old.schema(t)
			old.rows(t, 3)
			old.required(t)
			files, err := fs.Glob(DatlyResources, "datly_sql/*.sql")
			if err != nil || len(files) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("emitted resources=%v err=%v", files, err)
			}
			embedded, err := DatlyResources.ReadFile(files[0])
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			for index, store := range fixture.resources {
				data, err := store.ReadFile(DatlyResourceNamespace + ":" + files[0])
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if !strings.Contains(string(data), fmt.Sprintf("id <= %d", index+3)) || index == 0 && string(data) != string(embedded) {
					t.Fatalf("resource snapshot %d: %s", index, data)
				}
			}
			bad := t.TempDir()
			if err = os.CopyFS(bad, os.DirFS(stage2)); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err = os.Remove(filepath.Join(bad, "records", files[0])); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			fixture.stage = bad
			if err = manager.Reload(ctx, application.Request{Revision: 3, Compile: fixture.compile}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), files[0]) {
				t.Fatalf("missing-resource stage: %v", err)
			}
			if manager.Revision() != 2 || len(fixture.resources) != 2 {
				t.Fatal("failed stage changed publication")
			}
			current.schema(t)
			current.rows(t, 4)
			current.required(t)
			old.rows(t, 3)
			db.AssertQuery(t, ctx, sqlite.Query{SQL: "SELECT id FROM records ORDER BY id"}, []struct{ ID int }{{1}, {2}, {3}, {4}})
		})
	}
}
